title: At-will relationships and reliance loss
summary: Freedom to terminate a relationship can coexist with responsibility for an induced, determinate change of position.
notes: D&G Stout separates a concrete sale opportunity forgone from income hoped for over an undefined future period. Its comparison to at-will employment distinguishes moving costs and old wages forgone in preparing to move from new wages expected after employment begins. The court leaves reasonable timing and proof for trial and does not convert the relationship into permanent employment or distribution.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 138–143. Open assigned page 138.
